propositions: Each `_convert` invocation redundantly resolves `_pandoc_timeout()`, triggering `repo_root()` subprocess calls that execute `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` before config cache lookup, producing 886 extra subprocesses across 884 conversions.

Timeout resolution is session/render-pass invariant and should be computed once at the render boundary and threaded through `_render_unit` and `_convert` via optional parameters, preserving safe defaults for direct callers.
A render pass with three units must call `_pandoc_timeout()` exactly once, and an 884-unit trace must launch all 884 real Pandoc conversions with at most 3 git-root probes.
Per-unit fallback, timeout configurability, byte-equivalence to expected outputs, and process-group reap behavior must remain unchanged and covered by existing test suite.
